message.content: 视觉检查发现：`触点安排` 页大标题与副标题文字重叠，副标题不可读。先记录本批视觉评估。
message.reasoning_content:

positioning: The quote mark — "”" appears at right of slogan as a large gray decorative quote mark, actually rendered correctly in visual (looks like a proper closing quote glyph "”"). In the screenshot it shows two gray quote marks — looks fine visually. But in the text extraction it appears as `”` — that's likely the extraction of the raw glyph. Visually it's a decorative quote glyph that sits oddly floating to the right of the slogan block, mid-air after "把日常慢慢喝好". It looks like a stray large quote mark. Hmm, in the screenshot it appears as a big light "”" at approximately x=1030,y=790 — decorative, acceptable. Actually it looks a bit like a floating stray element but it reads as a quotation mark decoration. I'd say pass.

expression: good hierarchy, readable.

touchpoints: BLOCKER — subtitle text overlaps the huge title "触点安排": "按资料记录呈现触点类型、素材版本与覆盖门店；未给出的信息留作未确定项。" is overlapped by the giant title, making text illegible. Yes clearly overlapping — x range of subtitle starts at ~95 and the title characters overlap it. Yes that's a visual blocker on touchpoints.

Also cover: "品牌与门店运营团队" top-right in light gray, low contrast but okay.

Also positioning page: the "04" numbering missing? no. Fine.

Now record visual assessment for these 4 pages: issue on touchpoints (title/subtitle overlap). Then inspect batch 2 (cadence, boundaries).
